name: typeless-toolkit
description: Typeless 多账号管理、词库同步与桌面工具集（Windows WebView2 / macOS Electron）。
author: Typeless Toolkit contributors

scripts.check: node --check electron-main.js && node --check electron-preload.js && node --check manager.js && node --check typeless-dict-sync.js && node --check lib/common.js && node --check lib/platform.js && node --check lib/desktop-host.js && node --check lib/official-update.js && node --check scripts/prepare-mac-build.js && node --check scripts/hide-mac-build-app.js && node --check scripts/write-mac-checksum.js && node --check scripts/install-mac-build.js && node --test
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:mac && npm run generate:icon:mac && npm run check && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 && npm run hide:mac-build && node scripts/write-mac-checksum.js arm64
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run prepare:mac && npm run generate:icon:mac && npm run check && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal && npm run hide:mac-build && node scripts/write-mac-checksum.js universal
scripts.deploy:mac: npm run build:mac && npm run install:mac
